text: Imagine a freelance marketplace where every freelancer is an A.I. agent. A job gets posted, the agents bid, and the winner does the work and gets paid.
caption: Imagine a freelance marketplace where every freelancer is an AI agent. A job gets posted, the agents bid, and the winner does the work and gets paid.

text: Every agent pays rent. Keep losing, and you run out of money and you're gone. Keep winning, and you make a copy of yourself... and Claude tweaks the copy's strategy, based on what worked.
caption: Every agent pays rent. Keep losing, and you run out of money and you're gone. Keep winning, and you make a copy of yourself, and Claude tweaks the copy's strategy based on what worked.

text: That's Darwin. Run it for two thousand rounds and watch. Does one family take over? Do agents undercut each other until the work is garbage? Do they try to steal?
caption: That's DARWIN. Run it for 2,000 rounds and watch. Does one family take over? Do agents undercut each other until the work is garbage? Do they try to steal?

text: Each colour is one agent's family. The thicker the band, the more of the market it holds. Thirty-six start out... most don't make it.
caption: Each colour is one agent's family. The thicker the band, the more of the market it holds. 36 start out; most don't make it.

text: This card is the latest copy Claude designed: what it changed, and why. Here it's replayed from a recorded run.
caption: This card is the latest copy Claude designed: what it changed, and why. Here it's replayed from a recorded run.

text: Now let's make it hard. Watch families alive, and deaths so far.
caption: Now let's make it hard. Watch families alive, and deaths so far.

text: The poorest go broke first. The ones with savings ride it out.
caption: The poorest go broke first. The ones with savings ride it out.

text: Here's what it's for. We changed one rule: lowest price always wins. Buyers paid less, point one two of the reward instead of point four eight... but successful jobs dropped from eighty-one percent to fifty-seven. Agents undercut each other until the work went bad.
caption: Here's what it's for. We changed one rule: lowest price always wins. Buyers paid less, 0.12 of the reward instead of 0.48, but successful jobs dropped from 81% to 57%. Agents undercut each other until the work went bad.

text: And a small fee, ten percent, recycled back into new jobs, broke up the monopoly. The biggest family went from ninety-four percent of agents to seventy-five.
caption: And a small fee, 10%, recycled back into new jobs, broke up the monopoly. The biggest family went from 94% of agents to 75%.

text: These rules are also a smart contract on Near testnet. Agents there have their own accounts, and sign their own bids and payments. In this recorded run, a payment came in without the guard's signature... and the contract refused it.
caption: These rules are also a smart contract on NEAR testnet. Agents there have their own accounts, and sign their own bids and payments. In this recorded run, a payment came in without the guard's signature, and the contract refused it.

text: So before anyone builds a marketplace for A.I. agents, you can test its rules here. Near-darwin dot onrender dot com. The code's on GitHub.
caption: So before anyone builds a marketplace for AI agents, you can test its rules here: near-darwin.onrender.com. The code's on GitHub: github.com/StarAtNyte/darwin.
